verdict.rationale: Raygun documents deployment tracking to catch new errors/regressions and native repo integrations (GitHub/Bitbucket/GitLab) with source map decoding, which supports linking errors to code and deploys, but there's no explicit documentation of an issue view showing 'first seen in release X' or a specific 'suspect commit' identification per error. missing for 10: explicit per-issue release-first-seen labeling, suspect-commit/blame attribution feature, independent confirmation of this workflow.
